choices.content: The distances from the point to the endpoints of the two sides
The lengths of the perpendicular segments from the point to the two sides
The distance from the point to the vertex
The distances from the point to any points on the two sides

question.prompt: In the angle bisector property, “the distances from a point to the two sides of the angle” refers to:

solutions.explanation: The distance from a point to a line is the length of the perpendicular segment, so these are the lengths of the perpendicular segments \(PD\) and \(PE\) from \(P\) to \(OA\) and \(OB\).
solutions.title: Use the definition of distance to a line
